_about: Settings for Melbourne's Venues pages (engine/venues.py, engine/fetch_venue_events.py): the big live venues most of Greater Melbourne travels to, hand-kept; what's on at each from Ticketmaster's Discovery API; arrival notes in our own words, facts only. Hand-checked November 13, 2026: check capacities and arrival notes before a release, and the taxi figures every July.

feed._about: engine/fetch_venue_events.py: venue by venue (ids found once near each venue's point and saved in raw/venue_tm_ids.json). drop: words left out when matching the feed's venue names to ours.

fares._about: Flat figures the pages quote. Check them before a release; they go stale. No train or tram fare: Victoria made public transport free for a month and then halved fares for the rest of 2026, so a number would mislead. Taxi: Safe Transport Victoria's maximum fare for unbooked trips in metropolitan Melbourne from July 1, 2026, standard rate (up to four passengers): $4.60 flagfall and $2.35 a kilometre above 21 km/h (safetransport.vic.gov.au, fares and levies).

page._about: How engine/venues.py reads Melbourne: metropolitan trains (train_stations, train_lines) as the subway, V/Line as regional rail, the City's suburbs as the units, and Flinders Street and Southern Cross as the stations a trip from the suburbs and regional Victoria arrives at. Public car parks from the City's land use census. No fare figures for trains: Victoria halved fares for the rest of 2026, so a number would mislead; the taxi figure is Safe Transport Victoria's maximum from July 1, 2026.

venues.name: Melbourne Cricket Ground
homeOf: AFL’s Collingwood, Melbourne, Richmond and Hawthorn
venues.season: AFL football from March to September, finals in September; cricket from December, with the Boxing Day Test.
venues.arrive: Train to Jolimont-MCG or Richmond, then a walk through Yarra Park; trams along Wellington Parade or Swan Street
notes: Jolimont-MCG and Richmond stations are each a short walk through Yarra Park; Flinders Street is about 15 minutes on foot along the Birrarung Marr paths.

venues.name: Marvel Stadium
homeOf: AFL’s Essendon, North Melbourne, St Kilda and Western Bulldogs
venues.season: AFL football from March to September under a roof that closes; concerts and other events the rest of the year.
venues.arrive: Train to Southern Cross, then the footbridge over the tracks; trams on Bourke and La Trobe streets
notes: Inside the Free Tram Zone: trams along Bourke Street, La Trobe Street and Docklands cost nothing from the CBD.

venues.name: AAMI Park
homeOf: Melbourne Storm, Melbourne Victory and Melbourne City
venues.arrive: Train to Richmond, then a walk across the footbridge; tram 70 along Olympic Boulevard
notes: Part of the Melbourne and Olympic Parks precinct with Rod Laver Arena and John Cain Arena.

venues.name: Rod Laver Arena
venues.season: The Australian Open in late January; concerts all year.
venues.arrive: Train to Richmond or Flinders Street, then a walk; tram 70 along Olympic Boulevard

venues.name: John Cain Arena
venues.arrive: Train to Richmond, then a walk across the footbridge; tram 70 along Olympic Boulevard

venues.name: Arts Centre Melbourne
venues.arrive: Train to Flinders Street, then across Princes Bridge; trams along St Kilda Road stop at the door
notes: Hamer Hall, the State Theatre and the Playhouse are here; the State Theatre is the largest at about 2,000 seats.

venues.name: Sidney Myer Music Bowl
venues.season: Open-air, mostly from spring to autumn.
venues.arrive: Train to Flinders Street, then a walk across Princes Bridge and through the Kings Domain; trams along St Kilda Road

venues.name: Princess Theatre
venues.arrive: Train to Parliament; trams along Spring Street and Bourke Street

venues.name: Regent Theatre
venues.arrive: Train to Town Hall or Flinders Street; trams along Collins and Swanston streets

venues.name: Her Majesty’s Theatre
venues.arrive: Train to Parliament or Melbourne Central; trams along Bourke Street

venues.name: Forum Melbourne
venues.arrive: Train to Flinders Street; trams along Flinders and Russell streets

venues.name: Palais Theatre
venues.arrive: Trams to the St Kilda Esplanade and Acland Street; no train station nearby

venues.name: Festival Hall
venues.arrive: Train to Southern Cross or North Melbourne, then a walk; trams along La Trobe Street and Spencer Street

venues.name: Flemington Racecourse
venues.season: The Melbourne Cup Carnival in early November, races through the year.
venues.arrive: Trains run to Flemington Racecourse station on race days only; trams to Racecourse Road and Epsom Road
